analysis.summary: Lambda function names defined in routes are ignored by enrichRoutes function causing incorrect naming

bugs.title: functionName in routes ignored by enrichRoutes
bugs.description: The enrichRoutes function destructures only handler, timeout, and memorySize from the route config, ignoring the functionName field that was added to the Routes type and populated in the route definitions. It then unconditionally generates its own functionName using a hardcoded template, overriding any custom function names provided in the routes configuration.
bugs.risk: Lambda functions will be deployed with auto-generated names (BFF-...-STAGE) instead of the intended custom names (featureAppName-target-...), potentially causing naming convention violations, deployment conflicts, or difficulty identifying functions in AWS console. The explicit functionName values in routes serve no purpose and indicate incomplete implementation.

notBugs.reason: The URL rewriting logic appears intentionally removed as BFF routes now include the baseUrl path prefix, making path stripping unnecessary. Potential impact on .well-known or HTML extension handling is speculative without evidence of runtime failure.
Removal of pathRewrite aligns with BFF route changes to handle full paths including baseUrl, ensuring consistent behavior between dev server and deployed infrastructure.
